engineeringSkip.reason: Reality-anchor encryption assumes variable local physical constants usable as a cryptographic key, which has no basis in known physics or cryptography.

factCheck.reason: Fundamental constants like the Planck constant are the same everywhere, publicly measurable and cannot be varied or kept secret, so they cannot work as a private key — this is a science-fiction mash-up of physics words and cryptography with no real research behind it.
